name: analysis: two statistics per column of a tabular dataset
description: Pyodide over Galaxy tabular, the counterpart to analysis-csv-columns: same tool pair, different parse. The fixture is tab-delimited and its header is a comment line, so a run that treats `# Aminoacid` as data, or splits on commas, shifts every figure. Graded on two statistics rather than one because mean and median differ in every column here -- Buried is 151.82 against 158.1, Volume 86.69 against 87.4 -- so reporting one where the other was asked fails instead of passing quietly. Two columns rather than one, so a single lucky number cannot carry the run. Four figures rather than all fourteen: each survives rounding to one or two decimals, which keeps the assertion about the computation rather than about formatting.
inputs: Tell me the average value of each numeric column in the dataset in this history, and also their medians.
